WITH per_tx AS (
  SELECT t.transreg AS transreg, t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_short) AS base_short
  FROM per_tx
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT p.transreg AS transaction_reference, p.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, p.avg_short AS avg_short_interest, p.avg_opt AS avg_option_volume_ratio,
  CASE WHEN b.base_short IS NULL OR b.base_short = 0 THEN NULL ELSE p.avg_short * 1.0 / b.base_short END AS ratio
FROM per_tx p
LEFT JOIN baseline b ON b.ordertypedist IS p.ordertypedist
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN b.base_short IS NULL OR b.base_short = 0 OR p.avg_short IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
